http/transport_observation#

Whether a response started to arrive on an HTTP/1 connection.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Whether a response started to arrive on an HTTP/1 connection. Only a connection that got nothing back may be retried; HttpClient uses it.

Public API#

object HttpResponseObservation#

object HttpResponseObservation

Used only by an exclusive HTTP1 conversation. Includes partial and 1xx bytes; absence of a parsed final head is insufficient evidence for replay.
